scientific_limitations: Exact cyclic point Gauss–Seidel on normalized real three-dimensional equicorrelation SPD matrices only.
Euclidean one-complete-sweep error norm, not a uniform estimate for arbitrary SPD matrices or per-coordinate updates.
Preexisting positive-correlation sweep matrix and complex spectrum are explicitly acknowledged as prior work.
Historical specialist publication overlap cannot be ruled out; independent audit has not occurred.
title: Two sharp condition-number frontiers for Euclidean nonexpansion of three-coordinate Gauss–Seidel
